newsitem.title: USA: Miss USA wins Miss Universe competition.
newsitem.headline: Miss USA wins Miss Universe competition.

text.p: Miss USA, Brook Mahealani Lee, 26, was crowned Miss Universe at the international beauty pageant's finale at Miami Beach on Friday night.
Miss Venezuela, Marena Bencomo, 23, was declared first runner-up and Miss Trinidad and Tobago, Margot Bourgeois, 24, second runner-up.
The winner was crowned by last year's queen, Alicia Machado of Venezuela. A total of 74 women took part in the pageant.
Organisers estimated that 2.5 billion people in about 75 countries watched the live telecast from the Miami Beach Convention Centre.
The show was hosted by actor George Hamilton and Marla Maples-Trump, estranged wife of pageant owner Donald Trump.
